description: What the two ComfyUI boards hold right now (owner 05.11: two small boards, one tab each). Photos: at most 3 chains; an entry is a card id or {id, model, prompt: full|brief|brief-nogear|brief-anchor}. Video: at most 3 clips (scene ids with a prompt in specs/listing45_video.json or in the generated set); each starts on its own photo and the Frame Picker can swap it for any finished one. `set` = the reel set whose generated cards and clips (specs/sets/<set>.generated.json, made by scripts/director.py) join the hand-written ones. Normally written by scripts/director.py photos|pick. After editing run: py -3.12 -X utf8 scripts/build_comfy_workflows.py
